text_blocks.snippet: Scammers are actively targeting Central Illinois residents through phone calls, AI voice-cloning, text messages (smishing), and imposter schemes.
snippet_highlighted_words: phone calls, AI voice-cloning, text messages (smishing), and imposter schemes

list.snippet: Bank & Financial Phone Impersonation: Local institutions like Fisher National Bank and Federated Bank have warned customers about fraudulent phone calls. Scammers spoof caller ID to look like the bank and ask for sensitive login info or account numbers.

AI-Generated Voice & Romance Scams: The Peoria County Sheriff's Office reports an increase in AI-assisted scams, including fake romance connections and voice-cloning schemes that trick victims into wiring thousands of dollars.

State Agency & DMV Text Scams (Smishing): Phishing texts and emails impersonate the Illinois Secretary of State, the Illinois Department of Transportation, or tollway services, claiming you owe unpaid fines, tolls, or tickets and threatening to suspend your driver's license.

Federal & Court Impersonation Calls: The U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Central District of Illinois and the U.S. District Court have warned of scammers spoofing official phone numbers, claiming targets are under investigation (such as for sex trafficking) and demanding immediate payment or personal details.
Door-to-Door Energy Scams: Impersonators go door-to-door falsely claiming to represent local energy suppliers (like Homefield Energy) to trick residents into switching utility plans.
Never click links in unsolicited text messages or emails.

Hang up immediately if a caller claims to be from your bank, the court, or a government agency demanding payment or personal info over the phone. Call the official number listed on your bank statement or card directly.
Verify official portals by navigating directly to trusted sites like the Illinois Secretary of State rather than clicking links in texts.
Report suspicious activity to the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) or the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).
